actions: literal + reference + declaration + binding (END) + navigation (0) + correction (0) + submission (1) per program
goal: Declare each identifier once per program and reference it by role (B), against the minified (L-Om) and shared-style (L-R) literal baselines, with a rename-only attribution control (N); dev-val 100, every action counted
m1_gates: 400 of 500 frozen problems; at most 256 entries; median at most 32 and p95 at most 96 selections; at most 10% of selection bits from single-character entries; zero whole-solution entries; compare 128/7 and 256/8. Unchanged.

predictions.R1: L arms reproduce the minify-control-v1 Fdev dev-val selections exactly (41,394; 27,098; 14,014; 8,948).
predictions.R2: At both widths B-Om uses at least 15% fewer dev-val actions than L-Om, and more than 80 of 100 programs improve.
predictions.R3: At both widths B-R is not more than 1% below L-R in actions.
predictions.R4: No B arm is promoted at either width.
predictions.R5: At both widths declarations cost actions (B-Om above N-Om), and N-Om stays above L-R.
predictions.R6: Every decoded dev-val program in every arm decodes exactly and passes every frozen case.
predictions.R7: No arm meets the M1 indicator on dev-val (median <= 32, p95 <= 96, fallback <= 10%).

promotion.rule: Per width, a B arm is promoted only if, against both L-R and L-Om at that width: every dev-val program decodes exactly and passes every frozen case (P1); total actions at least 5% lower (P2); median and p90 actions both lower (P3); at least 60 of 100 programs improve and at most 25 worsen (P4). Among those, fewest actions, ties by package bytes with decoder. A conditional gain is the same test against the same-pool L arm only. Promotion permits proposing a separately frozen confirmation and the human study; it is not M1 and not a BITS candidate.

search.proposer: L: chosen-source spans only (minify-control-v1); B/N: absent END (B), the top 16 absent slots by dev-fit occurrences (support >= 2 problems), then chosen-source spans over text-contiguous runs
search.start: fallback alphabet (96); B also END. Greedy refill, matched80-v3 exact local search
